title: S$^2$LMR: Supervised Sequential Long-Context Multi-Step Retriever
abstract: arXiv:2611.28995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-step retrieval over long contexts is a key capability for retrieval-augmented generation, but strong existing approaches are costly and complex to train. Supervised retrievers are far simpler and cheaper, yet they fall well behind in this setting. We show that this gap stems not from supervised training itself, but from three misalignments between training and inference: easy training negatives, noisy retrieval prefixes, and position-agnostic scoring. Guided by this analysis, we introduce S$^2$LMR, a simple yet effective supervised sequential retriever that models multi-step retrieval as the evolution of an explicit textual state encoded by a single shared Transformer. On long-context reasoning, multi-hop QA, and needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks with context lengths ranging from 4K to 10M tokens, S$^2$LMR achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods, substantially outperforming prior supervised retrievers. translated_title: S$^2$LMR：监督式序列化长上下文多步检索器
translated_abstract: 在长上下文上进行多步检索是检索增强生成的关键能力，但现有的强大方法训练成本高昂且过程复杂。监督式检索器要简单和廉价得多，但它们在这一场景下表现明显落后。我们证明这一差距并非源于监督训练本身，而是源于训练与推理之间的三个不对齐之处：训练负样本过于简单、检索前缀存在噪声，以及与位置无关的打分方式。基于这一分析，我们提出了 S$^2$LMR，一个简单而有效的监督式序列检索器，它将多步检索建模为显式文本状态的演化过程，并由单个共享的 Transformer 进行编码。在上下文长度从 4K 到 1000 万 token 的长上下文推理、多跳问答以及大海捞针等基准测试中，S$^2$LMR 取得了与最先进方法相当的性能，并大幅超越了以往的监督式检索器。值得注意的是，它
tldr: S$^2$LMR 通过修复训练与推理之间的三大不对齐问题（负样本过易、检索前缀噪声、位置无关打分），利用单个共享 Transformer 将多步检索建模为显式文本状态的演化，使简单的监督式检索器在 4K 到 1000 万 token 的长上下文检索任务上达到与最先进方法相当的性能。
en_tdlr: S$^2$LMR addresses three train-inference misalignments (easy negatives, noisy retrieval prefixes, and position-agnostic scoring) and models multi-step retrieval as the evolution of an explicit textual state encoded by a single shared Transformer, enabling a simple supervised retriever to match state-of-the-art performance on long-context retrieval tasks with context lengths from 4K to 10M tokens.
